pages.title: Diving Helmet
pages.text: For Diving deeper than 5 meters from the surface, if becomes harder to just rely on a Snorkel. A Diving Helmet with some off-hand equipment, allows you to go much deeper.
The Brass Diving Helmet is a helmet that is made by forging Double-Sheets into a Half Helmet, then welding the two halves together and adding a lens for the visor in front.

pages.title: Air Hoses
pages.text: Using some leather, it is possible to knap a hose, that will grant you, when on your offhand and equipped with a Diving Helmet, one meter depth where air does not deplete.

A single hose is very bad, but a stack of them are not! The most you can carry is 16 of them, granting 16 meters from the surface where oxygen is not a problem! The hose stack even allows you to breathe even if a solid surface is above you. the hose will 'pathfind' to the nearest oxygen source.

pages.title: Air tanks
pages.text: For even deeper diving, an Air tank (or several) would be beneficial. As long as you have one in your offhand and a diving helm equipped, it will deplete the air inside instead of your own.
A tank starts as a Double Sheet that becomes a Cylinder in the anvil. Then, a Sheet needs to be welded to the Cylinder to close it off. Finally, weld a rod to it so you can use it to breathe.

Tanks come in Brass (lowest air), Steel, Black and Blue and Red Steel (highest air count). To refill a depleted air tank, place it on your normal hand, and use a bellows. It will refill fully in a while.
